name: @red-cup-engineering/punctuated-name-derivation-service
description: Transforms a Three Dots and a Dash punctuated name into the RMN (Relation Model Notation) term it denotes: mark(atom) for a bare atom, pair(previous, pair(mark(relation), mark(atom))) for each generation/witness/obstruction step, left to right. An address IS a typed RMN term; this is the boundary codec that reads a punctuated-name string as that term. A name containing an underscore returns {claim: "none"} (the paper's explicit escape, not a refusal); a malformed name returns a typed refusal naming the broken Expr/Atom rule. See README.md for the exact encoding, its totality/confluence argument, and the checkTy import obstruction.
